title: SATFormer: Learning When to Use Early Value Residuals in Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.03953v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent Transformer architectures expose later layers to representations computed in earlier layers, motivated by the observation that low-level features can become harder to recover as the residual stream is transformed through depth. One such method adds static value residuals: learned mixing coefficients that expose the first-layer value projection V_1 uniformly across tokens and heads. However, we theorize that the usefulness of $V_1$ is unlikely to be constant across tokens, heads, and contexts, and therefore treat early-representation reuse as a retrieval problem. Here, we introduce Selective Access Transformer (SATFormer), which preserves the first-layer value pathway while controlling access with a context-dependent gate. Across models from 130M to 1.3B parameters, SATFormer improves validation loss over the static value-residual and Transformer baselines at every evaluated scale, and improves average zero-shot accuracy

translated_title: SATFormer：学习何时在Transformer中使用早期值残差
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.03953v3 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：近期的Transformer架构让较深的层能够接触到较早层计算得到的表示，其动机在于观察到随着残差流在深度方向上不断被变换，低层特征会变得更难恢复。其中一种方法引入了静态值残差：即通过学习到的混合系数，将第一层的值投影 V_1 均匀地暴露给所有token和注意力头。然而，我们推测 V_1 的有用性在token、注意力头和上下文之间不太可能是恒定不变的，因此我们将早期表示的复用视为一个检索问题。为此，我们提出了选择性访问Transformer（Selective Access Transformer，SATFormer），它在保留第一层值通路的同时，通过一个依赖上下文的门控机制来控制对它的访问。在从1.3亿到13亿参数规模的多个模型上，SATFormer在每个评估规模下的验证损失均优于静态值残差和标准Transformer基线，并提升了平均零样本准确率。
tldr: 提出SATFormer，通过上下文相关的门控机制让每个token和注意力头动态决定何时复用第一层值残差，在从1.3亿到13亿参数的多个规模上均超越了静态值残差和标准Transformer基线。
en_tdlr: SATFormer introduces a context-dependent gate that dynamically decides when each token and head should reuse the first-layer value residual, outperforming static value-residual and standard Transformer baselines across model scales from 130M to 1.3B parameters.
